summary: In this brief talk, Jeanne Bliss reframes the business mindset by treating customers as the primary asset. She describes creating a leadership language and a meeting cadence that centers on customer metrics—specifically tracking how many customers are acquired, how many are lost, why losses occur, and how to fix the underlying issues. The aim is to shift the conversation from a sole focus on sales to a broader, customer-centric view and to embed customer outcomes into executive accountability.
title: Customers Are the Asset of the Business: Elevating Customer Metrics in Leadership Meetings
topics: Executive metrics for customer inflows and losses
